up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for CYP3A5, including substrate structures (canonical SMILES), compound names (pref_name), metabolic conversions, and pathway details.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure,
  md_s.pref_name AS substrate_name,
  met.met_conversion,
  met.pathway_key
FROM metabolism met
JOIN compound_records cr_s ON met.substrate_record_id = cr_s.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_s ON cr_s.molregno = md_s.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md_s.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE met.enzyme_name = 'CYP3A5'
LIMIT 200;
